description: Pinned Orlog (formerly Contract Labs) SLC bundles consumed by Tarquin. Build-time copies, not live path dependencies (ADR-0001 / MC-006 handoff rule). Each bundle is verified against its manifest artifact_hash before any fixture recomputation; drift rejects the bundle.

pins.hash_convention: MC-006: SHA-256 over every file under the bundle in sorted path order; path and payload NUL-separated; manifest.json included after deleting artifact_hash and serializing with sorted keys (JSON, 2-space indent, trailing newline).

MC-007 (MC-006 pattern): SHA-256 over every sealed node file in sorted bundle-relative path order; path and payload NUL-separated; the legal-grounding manifest included last after deleting bundle_hash and serializing with sorted keys (JSON, 2-space indent, trailing newline). Profiles may cite lex_refs ONLY from this pinned bundle; drift rejects.
